curation: public-safe subset of the internal S6 human semantic-validation lane, mirrored into the common-pose public repository
curation_basis: PI authorisation limited to the durable methodological definition of the lane (ontology, protocol, blinding spec, pre-registered analysis plans) plus the frozen formal ontology record. Aggregate endpoint results were NOT published because the formal round is not concluded as pre-registered.
copy_fidelity: source_sha256 and target_sha256 are computed independently. Four of the six files are byte-identical to source (equal digests). Two files carry exactly one class of edit, recorded per file under 'edits': a literal substitution of the original lane's local virtual-environment interpreter path in documented shell commands with the portable invocation 'python'. No computed number, threshold, label definition, endpoint or protocol statement was changed.

files.why_public_safe: Annotator-facing instructions and operator procedure for the instrument: it defines the label decision order, the fixed two-view rendering contract and the study controls, contains no per-annotator or per-sample data, and after the recorded substitution below carries no absolute path of any kind.
edits: all 13 occurrences of the local virtual-environment interpreter path in the documented shell commands were replaced by the portable invocation 'python' (for example 'python human_semantic_validation/tools/make_annotation_benchmark.py'). The local absolute path itself is withheld. No other byte of the document was changed.

this removes the only absolute paths present; the text introducing those commands ('Nothing above requires an environment variable ... work in a clean Windows shell') is a statement about the servers' own output handling and was left unchanged.

files.why_public_safe: The label ontology itself: the five primary classes, the diagnostic-only class, the three non-target codes, the closest-confusion discriminators and the stable storage codes; purely definitional and containing no annotator or sample information.
files.note: Pilot-1-era wording. The frozen FORMAL ontology is the later Pilot-3 thumb-base wording, recorded in formal_s6/ONTOLOGY_FREEZE.json (copied). Flagged in the target README.

files.why_public_safe: The blinding specification and its verification method: what the instrument is blind to, what the annotator sees, the physical separation of evaluator material, and the seven checks backing the claim; it names evaluator-side filenames as identifiers but publishes none of their contents, and after the recorded substitution below carries no absolute path of any kind.
edits: the single occurrence of the local virtual-environment interpreter path in the documented serve command was replaced by the portable invocation 'python'. The local absolute path itself is withheld. No other byte of the document was changed.
explained_token_hits: the token 'hidden' appears only as evaluator-side filename identifiers (hidden_sample_manifest / hidden_duplicate_map / hidden_payload_contract) and as prose stating that hidden directory contents are excluded from the served tree
no filesystem path into the lane's hidden directory is published; no hidden label or manifest content is reproduced

files.why_public_safe: A pre-registered, explicitly NOT-EXECUTED analysis plan: it fixes the endpoints, denominators, stratification, uncertainty convention and reporting rules in advance, and contains no computed result and no per-annotator or per-sample data.
explained_token_hits: the token 'hidden' appears only as the count of hidden duplicate items, which is part of the published instrument design (360 unique + 36 duplicates)

files.why_public_safe: The formal round's binding pre-registration: the human-only step, the definition of the primary evaluable set fixed before unblinding, the model-unblinded step as a specification, and the pre-recorded invalidity conditions; it reports no result and no per-annotator data.

The frozen formal ontology record: ontology id and protocol version, the frozen annotator-facing marking, the content hash of the semantic wording, the frozen benchmark shape (360 unique + 36 duplicates = 396 per annotator), SHA-256 values of the frozen artefacts, and the standing scientific commitments. It contains no label values, no per-sample content and no per-annotator data.
explained_token_hits: the token 'hidden' appears only as the names of evaluator-only manifest artefacts inside the frozen-benchmark hash table
only SHA-256 digests and byte counts of those artefacts are published, never their contents
no absolute filesystem path and no unblinding key is present

withheld.reason: Contain local absolute paths, per-annotator free-text notes and per-item per-annotator label assignments; the aggregate agreement figure alone was not separable from those.

verdict_on_lane_status: The instrument (ontology, blinding, sampling and pre-registered analysis) is complete and internally well controlled, but the FORMAL human endpoint is not concluded as pre-registered: no formal per-annotator export sits in the lane's own drop directory, an interim 200-of-396 checkpoint was nonetheless taken and deliberately model-unblinded in a diagnostic-only round, and the lane's own pre-registration required both annotators to finish all 396 items before any model output was computed.
verdict_evidence: observed: the lane's label drop directory (annotations/) contains only its placeholder file
observed: an interim checkpoint records two formal annotator exports at 200/396 labelled items each, with SHA-256 values and export timestamps
observed: the interim round's cohort-freeze record states the model-blinding status as intact at freeze and deliberately broken by that session thereafter
observed: the interim mechanism report states it is diagnostic only, is not the final 360-window estimate, and is not a model evaluation on the full benchmark
observed: the interim agreement figures are computed on the overlap of two partially labelled subsets (93 shared unique windows), which its own record states is not a random sample of the benchmark

observed: the formal runbook remains at status launched/awaiting annotators, which conflicts with the interim exports above; the true final completion state of the two formal exports could not be established from the workspace
not_established_here: whether either formal annotator completed all 396 displayed items (final exports may exist outside the workspace; the workspace shows no post-checkpoint export)
any semantic endpoint, decoder accuracy, or model-versus-human comparison for the formal benchmark
the intra-rater reliability of the formal annotators on the hidden duplicates
lane_integrity_at_read_time: The source lane was read only. Every source file touched by this curation was re-hashed after copying and matched its pre-copy digest; no file under the source lane was created, modified or deleted.
